checks.sourceMorphology: The native face keeps five fixed wings, the lower petal, the center column, and source mark coordinates.
checks.timeMapping: Twelve hour marks, sixty minute positions, and second-proportional nectar; noon and midnight use twelve hour marks.
checks.hostTests: All 86,400 local-time states; source nectar endpoint within half a pixel; all six source-coordinate, compiled-table, resource, and mask checks pass.
checks.build: SDK 4.33.1 build passes for basalt, chalk, diorite, emery, flint, and gabbro.
checks.memory: One 260-byte raster row; compile-time width guard; exact resource length and row-read checks; framebuffer released on both success and short read.
checks.graphics: Framebuffer writes respect round row bounds. Native time marks use Pebble drawing APIs; the asset generator prepares geometry at build time.
checks.cadence: Native reports record four frames over approximately 4.2 seconds on every target.
checks.native: The same final PBW installed and rendered on all six native emulators; seconds changed and noon/midnight rolled over naturally.

resolved.issue: The mask combined throat pixels on both sides of the center column into one interval.
resolved.change: Store up to two row spans so nectar cannot cover the column.
resolved.verification: Independent De Casteljau evaluation of the captured source path matches every mask pixel on all six displays.

limits: Physical-watch battery and minute-spot readability remain unmeasured. The small local-time readout gives the time directly.
